title: Margerie Glacier calving video
place: Margerie Glacier, Glacier Bay National Park, Alaska
audio: original audio kept (AAC stereo): calving roar/water
notes: Locked-ish telephoto of the Margerie ice face, 1920x1080 25->30 fps. 0-0.7 s a slab detaches from the face at x~0.45-0.5, y~0.35; 0.7-2.7 s it collapses straight down into the water; 2.7-6.7 s white splash/spray cloud spreads along the waterline (x~0.35-0.7, y~0.55-0.65); 7-15 s calm, ripples and reflection. Ice face fills the upper 60%. Action starts immediately (little setup). Shot A 0.0-2.6 (slab falls), shot B 2.4-5.0 (splash). Credit line required (CC BY): 'gails_pictures / CC BY 2.0'.
fact_en: It is about 0.85 miles wide, with an ice face that is about 200 feet high above the waterline.
